title: Create remote protocol identities
responsibility: Define protocol encodings and derive identifiers, challenges and request or credential hashes.

inputs.name: requestDigest.request
inputs.description: A WireRequest has type: "request", a string id, a method from remoteMethods and an input record; requestDigest reads only method and input, so type and id do not affect the digest.

inputs.name: remoteIdentity.publicKey
inputs.description: This is the public key whose bytes are hashed into a host or device ID; it accepts a byte array or base64url text. After decoding, it must be exactly 65 bytes and begin with 0x04; the function checks this uncompressed-point shape but does not validate the curve point.

inputs.name: credentialHash.binding
inputs.description: Binds a host or device role, host ID, optional device ID and credential into one digest; an omitted device ID is treated as an empty string. The type does not validate identifier or credential formats.

inputs.name: pkceChallenge.verifier
inputs.description: Verifier text is UTF-8 encoded and hashed with SHA-256 for the S256 challenge. This function does not validate RFC 7636 verifier length or characters.

inputs.name: randomId.bytes
inputs.description: Byte count passed directly to randomBytes; omission uses 16, and this function does not clamp or validate the count.

inputs.name: normalizeCode.value
inputs.description: The input string is uppercased, then all characters outside ASCII A–Z and 0–9 are removed. The result length is not checked.

outputs.name: remotePatterns
outputs.type: { readonly hostId: RegExp; readonly deviceId: RegExp; readonly pairingId: RegExp; readonly connectionId: RegExp; readonly epoch: RegExp; readonly requestId: RegExp; readonly key: RegExp; readonly nonce: RegExp; readonly credential: RegExp; readonly challenge: RegExp; readonly hash: RegExp; readonly sealed: RegExp; readonly code: RegExp; readonly projectId: RegExp; }
outputs.description: Maps host/device IDs (40 lowercase hex), pairing/connection/epoch IDs (32 lowercase hex), request IDs (8-4-4-4-12 lowercase hex), keys, nonces, credentials, challenges, hashes, sealed envelopes, pairing codes and local project IDs to their format regexes. Key, nonce, credential/challenge and sealed patterns allow 87, 22, 43 and 22–8192 base64url characters respectively; hashes are 64 lowercase hex, codes use eight characters from ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789, and local project IDs are local- followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.

outputs.name: remoteIdentity
outputs.description: Resolves to the first 40 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the accepted public-key bytes, for use as a self-certifying host or device ID.

outputs.name: credentialHash
outputs.description: Resolves to lowercase SHA-256 hex of the newline-separated protocol prefix, role, host ID, device ID and credential encoded as UTF-8. The device ID component is an empty string when omitted, and the hash function does not validate the field formats.

outputs.name: pkceChallenge
outputs.description: Resolves to the unpadded base64url encoding of the verifier's 32-byte SHA-256 digest, yielding 43 characters.

outputs.name: randomId
outputs.description: Returns lowercase hexadecimal encoding of the random bytes, with two characters per byte; the default 16-byte request produces 32 characters.

outputs.name: randomCredential
outputs.description: Returns unpadded base64url encoding of 32 random bytes, which is 43 characters.

outputs.name: pairingCode
outputs.description: Returns eight random characters from the code alphabet, formatted as four characters, a hyphen, then four characters; the alphabet omits I, O, 0 and 1.

outputs.name: normalizeCode
outputs.description: Returns the input uppercased with every character except ASCII A–Z and 0–9 removed; an empty result is allowed.

outputs.name: requestDigest
outputs.description: Resolves to lowercase 64-character SHA-256 hex of the method, a newline, and stable JSON for input. Object keys are sorted recursively, and the request ID is excluded.

errors.name: Malformed P-256 public key
errors.description: Thrown when base64url public-key text is malformed or the decoded/provided key is not exactly 65 bytes beginning with 0x04.

outputs.name: pairingCode
